nodes.text: $ZOE catches up with Spud!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Haven't run... Since freshman gym... In high school...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good thing I keep up my cardio...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Well, you caught me. Now what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope she knows what she's doing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It seems pretty obvious to me! The local zoo, right? Where else would there be hippos?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's talk on our way to the bus stop.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here we are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And there's O.M.G... Leaving on a city bus to the zoo!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Looks like we lose?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's okay Manda Panda. We'll beat them next time.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I just feel bad for them... They're heading to the wrong place.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... What?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You know... '`Hippos` on `campus.`' The clue was talking about the genus `hippocampus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You know... '[color=#3b78e2][i]Hippos[/i][/color] on [color=#3b78e2][i]campus.[/i][/color]' The clue was talking about the genus [color=#3b78e2][i]hippocampus![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hippocampus is the scientific name for `seahorses.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hippocampus is the scientific name for [color=#3b78e2][i]seahorses.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think Amanda just solved the riddle!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So we shouldn't be heading to the zoo at all...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We want to be on the bus to the `aquarium!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We want to be on the bus to the [color=#3b78e2][i]aquarium![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yep!
And so, fifteen minutes later, in the aquarium parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Like, wow! Congratulations, $ZOE! You guys are the first ones to arrive!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: That means you win the game... And the `huge` prize!
nodes.text_bbcode: That means you win the game... And the [color=#3b78e2][i]huge[/i][/color] prize!

nodes.text: Missy gestures to a box wrapped in bright wrapping paper.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! What could be inside?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe something expensive?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or something of cultural significance?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or a baby sloth!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's open it and find out!
$ZOE tears open the wrapping paper and finds...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...a coupon for a pizza?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: That's right. A `huge` pizza! It's even bigger than a large!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right. A [color=#3b78e2][i]huge[/i][/color] pizza! It's even bigger than a large!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Heh. I guess there are worse prizes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Definitely.
And so... An hour later.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This has got to be the best pizza I've ever had.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Can't... Stop... Eating.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Can't let Hector... Out-eat me!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's nice to see you so happy, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You looked a little sad when we first got here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For a second there, I was worried that we'd all changed too much. Like I didn't know you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess we didn't go to college to stay the same, right? We're supposed to change.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Or as my dad says, 'I'm not paying thirty grand a year for you to party.'

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So I had to evolve and make partying my business!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: All animals evolve over time! Even party animals!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But that's a good thing, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay if you guys change... As long as you stay my friends, okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Always.

nodes.text: After a few minutes of searching for Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Amanda! Amanda! Where are you?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Right here, silly! Sorry, I was chasing a butterfly! It's my favorite holometabolous insect!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm still getting used to you using such big words!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: 'Insect'? It's like a fancy word for 'bug.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Think you can help us with this clue?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'You won't find these `hippos` on `campus.` To reach the final stop, just hop on the right bus!
nodes.text_bbcode: 'You won't find these [color=#3b78e2][i]hippos[/i][/color] on [color=#3b78e2][i]campus.[/i][/color] To reach the final stop, just hop on the right bus!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, I know this one! Follow me!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow! That was fast!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's see here...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'You won't find these `hippos` on `campus.` To reach the final stop, just hop on the right bus!
nodes.text_bbcode: 'You won't find these [color=#3b78e2][i]hippos[/i][/color] on [color=#3b78e2][i]campus.[/i][/color] To reach the final stop, just hop on the right bus!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait a second... Wasn't the school's second president known as Walter 'The Hippo' Garfield?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought it was Walter 'The Hippie' Noles. He was school president during the '60s.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why are you guys talking about hippies?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I bet I could play a hippie girl! Now there's a role that would stretch my acting abilities!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! `Hippos!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! [color=#3b78e2][i]Hippos![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait... Are you calling us fat?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My mom warned me about the 'Freshman 15.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're wasting time.
As the group argues, Amanda skips up and reads the clue.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! Fun clue! We should go to the bus stop!
She skips into the distance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay! We've got the clue!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Time to play some catch up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's do it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's win this thing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, the next riddle reads...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'I shout loud and long, but only once a week. At the bottom of the stairs, you'll find the `goal` you seek.'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'I shout loud and long, but only once a week. At the bottom of the stairs, you'll find the [color=#3b78e2][i]goal[/i][/color] you seek.'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's easy! The `football stadium!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's easy! The [color=#e23b3b][i]football stadium![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was quick!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now we're rolling! Let's go!
With the team working together, the rest of the night goes by in a flash...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: 'Derivative' and 'Security' huh? It must be talking about the campus bank!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure 'The Prince of Cats' is a Shakespeare character...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There's a statue of Shakespeare right outside the English department!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Cats!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait a second! The Spanish department is a red herring! The 'language' they're talking about is a `computer` language!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second! The Spanish department is a red herring! The 'language' they're talking about is a [color=#3b78e2][i]computer[/i][/color] language!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How did you know that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm taking an intro computer science class!
And so, after several hours of searching...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... This graveyard is officially terrifying.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, I'd say the scariest thing about this place is right over there...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've finally caught up to the O.M.G. team!

nodes.speaker: Hayley
nodes.text: And just a little too late! We just figured out the final clue. Bye bye, losers!
The O.M.G. team runs off into the distance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There might still be time to catch them! Everyone, look around for that last clue!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here! Written on a fake gravestone!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'You won't find these `hippos` on `campus.` To reach the final stop, just hop on the right bus!
nodes.text_bbcode: 'You won't find these [color=#e23b3b][i]hippos[/i][/color] on [color=#e23b3b][i]campus.[/i][/color] To reach the final stop, just hop on the right bus!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's an animal question... Maybe Amanda would know?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think she wandered off that way, chasing a butterfly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're running out of time...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good call! Check this out...
She walks over to Spud.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's too bad you can't give us that clue, Spud...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I really wanted to finish up this silly game so I could head over to the 'Playbox One' release event tonight...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But now it looks like my two tickets are going to go to waste.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Ha! As if I'd actually believe that! I can tell just by looking at you that you don't play video games.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can you, Spud? Can you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When you look at me, maybe all you see is a bad girl. A tough chick with an impenetrable rock shell.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But what if you looked underneath. Maybe then you'd see those lonely Friday nights...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Those times when I stayed up past dawn storming the shores of Cannun-Doorn with a clan of social outcasts.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Those weeks when the only thing that got me out of bed was knowing my guild needed me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I needed them back.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: That... That was beautiful. I... Didn't realize you were a kindred spirit.
Spud hands Sam a piece of crumpled paper.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Here's the clue. Now maybe you can take me with you to that 'Playbox One' event later?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I'd never go to some dorky video game nerd-fest.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: But that speech you just made...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Was from season six of 'Fluffy the Zombie Slayer.' I memorized it for my last audition.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Touche, madam. Touche.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go. Now. Go find your pathetic little team.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Ah! Scary!
He runs off into the night.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nice work, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Time to break out some classic angry girl threats!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can threaten him with wedgies and swirlies and pantsings!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure I'm into using 'advanced interrogation techniques.'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That would basically make me a bully.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And anyway, I don't want to be typecast as the 'scary angry girl' anymore. I'm so much more than that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's good, I guess... But what about making him hand over the riddle?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... If it's for the good of the team, I'll see what I can do.
She walks over to Spud.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... Uh, hand over the riddle, or I'll make you sorry. I guess.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Uh... Was that supposed to be a threat? Because that wasn't convincing at all.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: You've got to really dig deep! Scare me! Tell me you're going to feed me to your pet ferrets!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry. My heart's just not in this performance.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: So disappointing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait let me try again!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, give us the clue or I'll... Punch you?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Even worse!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Just take the clue, okay? I can't watch any more, and I need to rejoin my team.
He hands Sam a piece of paper and walks off into the night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Yay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right. Yay.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's just move on... The game's not lost yet, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now it's time to hand over the next clue, Spud!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All we want is your team's copy of the clue... So hand it over!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Or... What? You'll bake me a pie with a less than perfect fruit to dough ratio?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I'm not scared of you.
Sam pulls $ZOE aside.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE... Maybe you should let me talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good idea!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can use your, uh, unique set of skills.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what skills would those be?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know... I'm talking about...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! Where'd he go?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Keep looking... We'll find him eventually.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emphasis on `eventually.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Emphasis on [color=#3b78e2][i]eventually.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: It's too late now... The game is lost.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess we're not as good a team as I thought.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe we've all just grown apart...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The loss of a friendship once held dear...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I'll write a play about this!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now that this game is over, it's time we talked about the `real` reason I'm here...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now that this game is over, it's time we talked about the [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] reason I'm here...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Who wants to hear about a `fantastic` financial opportunity?
nodes.text_bbcode: Who wants to hear about a [color=#e23b3b][i]fantastic[/i][/color] financial opportunity?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've got one word for you... `Timeshare!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I've got one word for you... [color=#e23b3b][i]Timeshare![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't how I wanted things to end...
And in her heart, $ZOE knows that...
She has failed.

nodes.text: Look, I'm sure this is all a big joke to you, but I'm really stressing out! You know how much I like Arinna! She's the most perfect girl I've ever met... And this is my best chance to make a move!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: That's why... Why I got this.
You reach into your jacket pocket and take out a small, pearl orb. It has a single, smooth indentation on its face.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Uh... What's that?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's an Orb of Home's Remembrance. I got it off that junior, Shawn.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: You mean Shady Shawn? The guy who's always getting suspended for stealing magical objects?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: So he's got a troubled past! That doesn't mean he can't help me now!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: What does that Orb do, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's perfect! Ask yourself this... What does Arinna want most in the world?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: To not get hit on by every guy at Spellclaive?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: No! It's to see her home again! She's a Princess, after all. Don't you think she misses her palace, her family, back in the Wilde?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: And this Orb will help with that?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: According to Shawn--

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Shady Shawn.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: According to Shady Shawn, if you press the button and hold it, it'll show you your happiest memories of home. That's exactly what Arinna wants!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I'll let her use the Orb, and she'll be so impressed with how sensitive and compassionate I am, she'll realize I'm the guy for her!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, that's certainly one way to do it.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Could I propose something a little crazier and more far-fetched, like, I don't know, just telling her how you feel?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: That's easy for you to say! You've got your rugged good looks and scruffy charm and soft, come-hither eyes...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Well, now I'm uncomfortable again.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Trust me, Luke. This is my best shot. And I need to--
Just then, there's a knock on the door!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's her! Go, go!
Luke rolls his eyes and walks over to the door. When he opens it, Arinna's on the other side, looking absolutely radiant.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Why hello, Luke! Are you here to study with us as well?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Oh no, I'm not taking Linguistics 'til next semester. This is all you and Simon. And believe me he's been looking forward to it!
You make a noise that's half cough and half gurgle.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I'm going to go hit the library! Have fun, you crazy kids!
Luke walks out. Arinna drifts in, looking around, then makes her way to the desk.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: So, uh, can I get you anything? Some water? Some juice? A refreshing back rub? A--
By the time you turn around, Arinna has somehow covered your entire desk in Linguistics textbooks!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I must tell you, Simon, I've been really looking forward to this! I've never had a... How do you say... Study brother?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Study buddy, actually... I hope...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: How delightful! I do like your language's tendency towards rhyming!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Now where should we start? The phonemes of the Olde Tongue? The dictions of Deep Earth magic? Or maybe we could do something a little more fun, like the guttural cants of the Slavic mages?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah... Those all sound... Great...
You look into your palm, where the Orb of Home's Remembrance is resting... Then take a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh hey! Look here! A magical object I just happened to find!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: What? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's some kind of shiny, magical orb! Whatever do you think it could do?
You hold out the orb to her, but she backs away warily...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon, I'm sensing tremendous power off of that Orb... I don't think you should be playing with it...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Just hold onto it for one moment, would you? I bet something cool will happen...
You shove the Orb to her, but she pushes it away... And causes your finger to hit the button! The Orb starts to glow and pulse!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oops.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon, you've activated it!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: That... that wasn't supposed to happen...
The air around you crackles with magical energy! Your hair stands on end! The walls seem to bend and twist...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: This `definitely` wasn't supposed to happen!
nodes.text_bbcode: This [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] wasn't supposed to happen!

nodes.text: You feel a sudden jerking sensation like you're being pulled by a sharp current! You shoot your hands out and grab Arinna desperately...
There's a hot, white `POP` and a hard, wrenching feeling...
nodes.text_bbcode: There's a hot, white [b]POP[/b] and a hard, wrenching feeling...

nodes.text: And then the two of you are standing in a suburban living room. You slump over, woozy, and Arinna wobbles next to you...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: That... That was a rite of transportation...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It certainly was...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: But where are we? Where have we gone? What is this place?
You look around for a moment and see the giant, flatscreen TV... The bowl of chips on the coffee table... The dozen football trophies on the mantelpiece...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh no... Oh please no...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You know where we are?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: `Oh no...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oh no...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: What is it, Simon? Are we in the Wilde? The Dark Lands? The Marrow Fields of Rahk'Azhul, where the shades of the dead wear the skins of the living?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: No... We're somewhere so much worse...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: `Ohio.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ohio.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh-hai-yo? Is this an Earth kingdom?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: A state, actually. My state. This... This is my home, Arinna. We're in my home.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: ...Really? But that's delightful!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Delightful?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I've always dreamed of visiting the lands of Earth outside of Spellclaive! And you've told such exciting stories about your life at home!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I want to meet all those friends you talk about... See all the trophies you've won... And maybe meet some of those beautiful girlfriends that you used to dally with!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Ah yes. These are all things I said, which are all absolutely true and in no way lies.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: If you'll excuse me, I need to... Do... A thing. Please wait here.
You run upstairs into your bedroom as fast as you can, dig through your stuff for a spare cell phone, and frantically dial a number...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Hello? Who's this?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Luke! It's me!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Simon? Why are you calling me? And how are you calling me from an Ohio number?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: The Orb didn't work! Instead of giving Arinna visions of her home, it teleported the two of us to `my` home!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Orb didn't work! Instead of giving Arinna visions of her home, it teleported the two of us to [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] home!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Hmm, it's almost like there's a lesson here... Something about not buying magical objects from Shady Shawn...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, you can make fun of me for it later! Right now, I need you to figure out how to get us back to Spellclaive, stat!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Okay, okay, hold on...
You can hear the sounds of Luke sliding over to a Terminal of Lore and digging through its interface...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Small white orb... Teleportation... Took you home...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Okay, jackpot. Looks like Shawn didn't sell you an Orb of Home's Remembrance, but an Orb of Home's Return. They look a lot alike, actually. It's an easy mistake to make.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, well, how do I reverse it?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: According to this, the Orb is meant to let travelers return home for brief visits. It takes about eight hours for the Orb to recharge its magical energy between uses, and then it should let you go right back to where you came from.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Eight hours? Oh no, no way, `no way.` We can't just hang out here for eight hours!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eight hours? Oh no, no way, [color=#e23b3b][i]no way.[/i][/color] We can't just hang out here for eight hours!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Why not? What's wrong with your home? I bet Arinna would get a kick out of seeing it...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah? And how about finding out that I'm not a cool, popular, ladies' man but an awkward, dorky nerd with no friends? Think she'd get a kick out of that?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: You told her you were a ladies' man?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I didn't think it would get put to the test!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Look, just stay calm and try to act like it's all intentional, okay? You just have to make it eight hours. After that, you're home free... No pun intended...
Just then, you hear the rumble of an engine. You look out the window to see a huge, bright-yellow SUV rolling into the driveway...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh crap! My dad's here! I gotta go!
You hang up your phone and rush back downstairs...
Where Arinna is sitting on the couch, watching a daytime talk show!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon! I've just been watching this fascinating cultural record! I had no idea relationships on Earth were so complicated!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It appears that this woman somehow found herself bethrothed to three separate sets of brothers...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, I'll explain that later! My dad's here!
You can hear the sound of heavy footsteps tromping towards the front door...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh crap... I can't let him see you! He'll freak!
You scramble across the room and grab a cap, pulling it onto her head so it covers her ears.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oof!
The door swings open, and your father steps in, a hulking man in a coach's uniform. He freezes when he sees you...

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Simon?!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...Hi, Dad.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: What are you doing here? I thought you were off at the fancy-pants boarding school... You know, for smart kids...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's, uh, our spring break! And I thought I'd stop by and surprise you with a visit... But only for a little while... Because... I'm on a road trip!
Your father first notices Arinna.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Who's this?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh! This is my good friend from school! Her name's... Uh...
Arinna steps forward, offering her hand with an elegant flourish!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I am Princess Arinna T'Karra, Scion to the Throne of Va'el Tellorion, and rightful ruler of the lands of the Wilde!
Your father stares at her for a moment, then sighs.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Well. You're Simon's friend, all right.
You stand there awkwardly for a moment, staring at your feet...

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: So. Um. How's, uh, school? Are you... You know... Studying?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...Yeah. I'm doing that.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yup.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Reading books?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Good, good. Books are good.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: You... Um... Playing any sports?
Your father's eyes flit over to Arinna, who is curiously sniffing the remote control...

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Probably not.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Well... Listen... I'd, uh, love to stay and talk, but I need to go to my office... It's Homecoming tonight, and Calvin's coming over to go over some game tapes...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Calvin's coming here? Calvin Crash?!
Just then, the doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: That must be him now! Calvin! Come in!
The door to the living room swings open, and a tall, handsome high-schooler steps in.

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Coach D!

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Calvin! You ready for tonight's big game?

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: I'm ready to rock and roll, Coach! I'm ready to bust some skulls! I'm ready to make you proud!
Your father claps Calvin warmly on the back.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: I'll go get those game tapes, okay? You wait right here!
Your father runs upstairs. Calvin plops down on the couch next to you...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Holy crap... Dorky Drevin! Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I prefer Simon, actually...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, Dorky Drevin. Man, I haven't seen you in ages! Remember that time me and my buddies chased you out of the locker room wearing just a hand towel?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It was memorable, all right.

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: What are you doing here, anyway? Didn't you get sent off to some school for nerds?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's a school for the gifted, actually, and I--

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, whatever, nerd school. Did you hear about our season? 7-0, baby! Calvin Crash is taking this team to State!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I thought we were already in a state...
Calvin freezes, noticing Arinna for the first time...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Whoa... Simon... Who is your friend?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh, please don't look at her like that...
Arinna crosses over, extending a hand.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: My name is Princess Arinna Va'el Tell--
Calvin cuts her off, pressing two fingers gently to her lips.

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Shh, baby. Shhhh. Why don't I just call you beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I... Suppose that is acceptable... If it is your local custom...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Errrrrghhhh...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And what should I call you?

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: I'm Calvin Crash, baby! I'm the star running back of the Dellton Bobcats! I'm the best there ever was, the Grandmaster of the Gridiron!

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Listen, I have a great idea! Why don't you two come out to the Homecoming game tonight? I'm throwing a party after, and it is going to be a `rager...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, I have a great idea! Why don't you two come out to the Homecoming game tonight? I'm throwing a party after, and it is going to be a [color=#e23b3b][i]rager...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh, no, we couldn't possibly--
Just then, your father rushes down, holding dozens of tapes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Got 'em, Calvin! Now let's head on back to the fieldhouse to review.

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Sure thing, Coach!
Calvin rushes out, but not before giving Arinna a wink...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: See you later, beautiful.
He leaves. Your father follows after, stopping to look at you.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: So. Simon. Are you going to be around after the game?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Um... Probably not...

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Well, then... It was good seeing you...

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Good luck with the... You know... Studying...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Right... Good luck at the game...

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Right...
Your father steps in like he might hug you, then awkwardly steps back and leaves. You watch him and Calvin drive away...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Bye, Dad...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I don't understand. Are we not going to see him at this 'Homecoming' game, and the subsequent party?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh, we weren't going to actually go to those...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon, I may not know much of your home state's customs, but am I wrong in believing that this Calvin Crash is a figure of great local repute? A Grandmaster of Great Iron?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, well, close enough...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Then surely we can't decline his invitation! I may be outside of my Kingdom, but I am still its representative, and as such, I must honor an invitation by another dignitary!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Look, there must be `some` way I can talk you out of this...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, there must be [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] way I can talk you out of this...

nodes.text: Two hours later, you and Arinna sit in the stands at the Dellton High football field.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Well, this is happening.
Confetti flutters down from above. The band plays a rousing refrain. Cheerleaders flip and twirl.
Arinna watches it all with rapt interest.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh, Simon! This festival is marvelous! What god are your people honoring?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...America?
The football players march onto the field, as the ref begins the coin toss.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: This is a sport, yes? A contest of strength and strategy between your greatest champions?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You must tell me the rules!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I... Actually... Don't really know them...
Arinna stares at you in disbelief.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's normally a game for... Warriors... And I'm of the scholar... Caste?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Ohhhhhh.
An hour later... Calvin hurls his arms up triumphantly in the end-zone, having scored his second touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: So the runners must get the ball down into the colored area at the field, while the defenders shield them from the attackers! We had a game just like this in my Kingdom!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Really? I kind of doubt that...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh, yes! It was called Kai'chkul! A group of convicted murderers had to carry a flaming orb across a field lined with spikes and beset on all sides by great beasts called Shamblers!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It was outlawed several years ago, however. Our healers found that the repetitive head injuries were causing too much long-term damage.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...I stand corrected. They're surprisingly similar.
And another hour later...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Whoo! Go Dellton Bobcats! Run that ball and find glory on the battlefield! Crush your enemies and bask in their blood!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: You are really into this...
Until finally...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Woohoo, baby! Dellton Bobcats win again! `Dellton Bobcats win again!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Woohoo, baby! Dellton Bobcats win again! [color=#e23b3b][i]Dellton Bobcats win again![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Hurrah! Hurrah!
Your father rushes across the field and grabs Calvin in a great hug. You can't remember the last time he even gave you a pat on the arm.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...Hurrah.
The football players hoist Calvin up and carry him off the field. You glance down at your watch.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Well, we've got two and a half hours left until the Orb is working again. We should probably just go home and wait...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: But what of the party that Calvin invited us to? Surely we must celebrate the victory of the Dellton Bobcats over the hated Middlebrook Vikings!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...Must we?
Half an hour later, you're at a noisy party at Calvin's house. Jocks lounge around, celebrating their win, while pretty, popular girls hang around by the pool.
You stand alone. All around, you can feel people staring at you, and you know what they're whispering... 'What's Dorky Drevin doing here?'

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...Being pretty miserable.
Across the room, Arinna stands at a pong table, surrounded by excited high-schoolers. She tosses the red ball, whispers a spell, and watches it gracefully sail into the one remaining red cup.
The crowd around her whoops and cheers!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I don't know why everyone is so excited... I mean, this is the easiest game of Spell Pong `I've` ever played...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know why everyone is so excited... I mean, this is the easiest game of Spell Pong [color=#3b78e2][i]I've[/i][/color] ever played...

nodes.text: You sigh, watching her... And then a firm hand slaps you on the back, so hard it knocks you forward!

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Dorky Drevin! My man! So glad you could make it!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Right. Congrats on the victory.

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Of course! Calvin Crash brings home the wins, baby! Calvin Crash brings home the wins!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: When did you start talking about yourself in the third person...?
Calvin steps in close, his arm around your shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Now then. About your super-hot friend. She, uh, she single?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Well... I... I mean, technically, yes, but... But...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: But what?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: But... Look, Calvin, I know you're the big man here, and I know you're used to everyone fawning all over you and making out with whoever you want...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: But Arinna... She means the world to me. I'm just crazy about her.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: So I'm asking you, if not as a friend, then as a decent human being, can you just hit on someone else?
Calvin doesn't say anything for a moment, then he squeezes your shoulder, hard and painful. He leans in and talks in a low whisper...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Look here, Drevin. When I saw you today, I thought maybe I'd be a nice guy for once, you know, invite you to my party and whatever.

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: But I'm telling you right now. Calvin Crash gets what Calvin Crash wants. And Calvin Crash wants some of that slender, blonde beauty.

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: And if you get in between us... I'll make sure you regret it for the rest of your life.
Calvin steps forward, then casually drives his elbow back into your stomach as hard as he can. It knocks the wind clean out of you.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Hffff!
You fall back. Grinning, Calvin struts over to Arinna...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Hello there, beautiful! Looks like you're as skilled as you are gorgeous...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Why, thank you! I was very impressed with your prowess during the game! Truly, you must be one of Oh-hai-yo's greatest warriors!

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Ha! You bet I am!
You can't take any more of it. Your eyes burn with tears. You turn around and storm upstairs...
Bursting into Calvin's bedroom! You slam the door behind you and march over to the bed, furiously kicking at it!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Stupid Calvin! Stupid football! Stupid town!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I hate this place! `I hate this place!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I hate this place! [color=#e23b3b][i]I hate this place![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As you slump onto the bed, the door behind you swings open...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon? Are you in here?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh! I... I just... I...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Are you crying?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: No! This is just... Face water... It's a thing we do here on Earth...
Arinna walks over and takes a seat next to you on the bed.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon. I may be new to your customs, but I know tears when I see them.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: What's wrong?
You sit up with a sigh. You just can't bear to lie anymore.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Arinna... The thing is... I haven't been honest with you.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I'm not popular or cool here. And I've never even had a girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I'm a nerd, Arinna. An outcast. A loser. Calvin and his friends used to beat me up every day. Everything I told about my home was a lie.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You lied to impress me?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I lied to impress everyone. When I got invited to Spellclaive, it was my chance at a fresh start. A chance to be someone new. Someone cool. Someone who... Who could hang out with a girl like you.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon, you didn't have to lie to be my friend.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: You say that, but... You just don't know what it was like here. I hated it so, so much. The day I left for Spellclaive was the best day of my life.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I never, `ever,` wanted to come back.
nodes.text_bbcode: I never, [color=#e23b3b][i]ever,[/i][/color] wanted to come back.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: But what of your father? You must miss him...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Don't you get it? My father's the worst of all!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It was okay before my mom died, but now it's like he doesn't care about me at all.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: All he cares about is football, about winning with his team, about bringing home more trophies!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: That's not true...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: No, it `is` true! Did you see him today? He hasn't seen me in six months, and he showed more affection to Calvin Crash!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] true! Did you see him today? He hasn't seen me in six months, and he showed more affection to Calvin Crash!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: My dad doesn't love me, Arinna. He never did!
Arinna is silent for a moment. Then she scoots over to you and talks slowly, softly, her head bowed low.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: The last time I saw my father... We were fighting.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Wh... What?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: We didn't get along. He was a good King, brave and wise, but a distant father, always preoccupied. How could he not be, with the forces of the Doombringer rising?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I didn't see it that way, of course. I was just a girl. I didn't understand.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: That morning, he came to tell me that he was sending me and Priam away to Spellclaive. He was worried that it was too dangerous for us in the Wilde, for the entire royal family to be gathered in our citadel of Va'el Tellorion.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I was furious. I had a life there, friends to see, parties to go to. And he wanted me to leave it to go into another world, to hide at some school with humans, for who knows how long?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I yelled at him. I cried. I... I called him a coward.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: You were understandably upset...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: That night, the Doombringer struck.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Cowards within our Council, swayed by promises of power and gold, brought down the magical barriers that shielded Va'el Tellorion from invaders.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: The Doombringer's minions, orcs, goblins and worse, flooded the Citadel, slaying everyone in their paths. My friends... My family.
A single golden tear streaks down Arinna's cheek.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I would have died too, if Priam hadn't come to get me. He led me out through hidden tunnels, to the sacred Wildestone in the forest behind the Citadel.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It turns out he and my father had been powering it up for months, using the energy of many of our mages. That's one reason the barrier fell so easily. Because my father was trying to protect me.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: As we fled through the trees, I looked back just once... And saw my father standing on the parapet of the castle, watching me go.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I saw his eyes then, in the moonlight. And even though his kingdom was falling around him, even though he knew he would surely die, his eyes were happy to see me safe. His eyes were full of love.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Then the Doombringer himself rose up behind him, riding his great Drake, the black beast whose leathery wings blot out the sky...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And then there was only fire.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Arinna, I... I'm so sorry... I had no idea...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: And here I was going on about my problems... I'm so stupid...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It's okay, Simon. I didn't tell you to upset you. I told you so you'd understand.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I know a father's love when I see it. And your father loves you. He may not know how to express it, just like you don't always know how to express your love for him, but he cares for you very, very much.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: You... You really think so?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I know so. And I think deep inside, you do too.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Arinna, I--
You're cut off by the sound of the door slamming open. Calvin bursts in, looking furious!

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Well, well, well. What do we have here?

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: I told you to stay away from her, Dorky Drevin, and what did you do? Bring her up to my room for a little make-out sesh?!

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: I am going to whoop you so hard...
Calvin steps towards you, but Arinna stands in his path.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You will do no such thing...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Oh, don't worry, baby. Once I'm done with the dork here, you'll have plenty of Crash time...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Try to touch me, pig, and you will face the consequences.

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Oh, I'm so scared...
Calvin steps forward, reaching for Arinna...
And you intervene, decking him with a solid punch!

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Oooof!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I... I punched him. I punched Calvin Crash! I can't believe I just did that!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And he's from the Warrior caste, too!
Calvin picks himself off the floor, growling as he cracks his knuckles...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: You are dead meat, Drevin! `Dead meat!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You are dead meat, Drevin! [color=#e23b3b][i]Dead meat![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Arinna steps forward! The air around her sizzles with magical energy, and her cap burns away!

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: What the... Who are you?!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I am Princess Arinna T'Karra of the Wilde...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And no one threatens my friends!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: `Typhon Turbi Expulso!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Typhon Turbi Expulso![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A massive blast of wind shoots out of Arinna's hands and slams into Calvin! It sends him hurtling back, smashing clean through his bedroom wall, and into the branches of a nearby tree!
Below, the music stops immediately. The night is completely silent, until distantly, you can hear Calvin moan...

nodes.speaker: Calvin Crash
nodes.text: Calvin... Crash... Hurts...
Dozens of people rush outside, shouting...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon... I may be unfamiliar with your customs here... But it seems now would be a good time to flee.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: That is an excellent observation!
Minutes later, the two of you sprint through the neighborhood and duck around an old fence!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Are we clear?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Hff... Hff... I think so...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Arinna, that... That was...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: So awesome! Hahaha!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It was?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I just watched a beautiful girl throw Calvin Crash through a wall using magical powers! It's like someone reached into my middle school fantasies and made them real!
Arinna looks away, blushing.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You... You think I'm beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Well... I... That is to say... You're... Well...
Something buzzes in your pocket. You reach in and take out the Orb, which is glowing again.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh! The Orb is charged again! We can go back to Spellclaive!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: As much as I'd like to stay, we should get back... I imagine Priam is getting quite upset...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Sure, sure... But if you could give me just ten minutes... There's one last thing I need to do.
You rush back into your house. Inside, your dad is scrambling around frantically...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Hey, Dad.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Oh! Hello, son! I... I really can't talk right now. I need to get to the hospital.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Apparently, Calvin hurled himself through a wall at some stupid party tonight and broke half a dozen bones.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Our whole season's shot, and if that wasn't bad enough, that idiot's apparently lost his mind as well... He's going on and on about how some magical elf girl shot him with her mutant powers...

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: I swear... That kid can run like a demon, but he's dumb as a bag of rocks.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...Heh.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I... I was just distracted. Is there something you want?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I just wanted to say bye before I left.
You step forward and give your dad a big hug. He startles, then hugs you back, first clumsily, then naturally.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: That and... I love you, Dad.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: I... Uh... I love you too.

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Ahem, now, uh, go on. Get back to that fancy-pants school of yours and do me proud.
Your dad looks around and then leans in, whispering...

nodes.speaker: Coach Drevin
nodes.text: Oh, and if I were you, I'd ask that funny friend of yours out on a date. I think she likes you.
Your dad pats you on the back and walks out. A moment later, Arinna comes in.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Ready to go back to Spellclaive?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Let's do it.
Arinna takes your hand and laces her fingers through yours. You can feel your heart pounding in your chest. You take out the Orb, close your eyes, and press the button...
And then you and Arinna are standing back in your room at Spellclaive!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Phew. Glad that worked. I was a little worried we'd warp somewhere else from my past, like that summer camp where they made me eat bugs.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You'll have to tell me that story some day.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: They made me eat bugs. That's the story.
She squeezes your hand, still in hers...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Thank you for showing me your home, Simon. I so enjoyed seeing your culture and watching the game of Feudball.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I should probably get going now... I imagine my brother has torn this place upside down looking for me. Once he finds out where I went, you would do best to stay out of his way for some time.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Will do. And I had fun too.
Arinna starts to go. As she does, you call after her...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Hey... Listen... Sometime when your brother's calmed down... Do you want to... Meet up?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You mean, actually study Linguistics?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, sure... Or just... You know... Hang out...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: ...It would be my pleasure.
Arinna turns and leaves. You watch her go for a minute, then flop back on the bed.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh man...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Best Homecoming ever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoops! Sorry!
Suddenly, she hears a siren, and police lights pierce through the darkness.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I knew I'd catch a Jenny Jaywalker if I staked out this intersection long enough!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Officer Monte? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm on vacation!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You spend your vacation busting jaywalkers in far away cities?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No better way to unwind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess Spud is getting away...

nodes.title: College Scavenger Hunt
nodes.subtitle: $ZOE and Howard are back in this Halloween adventure with their old Centerscore friends!

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE.
It's Halloween, and $ZOE and Howard are ordering drinks at the Kingston University coffee house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll have one coffee... and one hot chocolate with extra whipped cream.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, actually, better make that two coffees.

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Coming right up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Since when did you start drinking coffee?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Since I decided to take eighteen units this semester!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got so swamped I had to pull out last year's Halloween costume instead of getting a new one!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And now we've got a `long` night ahead of us.
nodes.text_bbcode: And now we've got a [color=#3b78e2][i]long[/i][/color] night ahead of us.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's right... The annual `Kingston Halloween Scare-venger Hunt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right... The annual [color=#e23b3b][i]Kingston Halloween Scare-venger Hunt![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe it's actually named that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remind me what the details are...
$ZOE takes a flyer out of her book bag and reads it aloud.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'The `Kingston Halloween Scare-venger Hunt!` A devious series of riddles that will take you and your team on a cross-campus quest!'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'The [color=#3b78e2][i]Kingston Halloween Scare-venger Hunt![/i][/color] A devious series of riddles that will take you and your team on a cross-campus quest!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'The game begins at sunset... Be the first team to reach the final location and win a `huge` prize!'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'The game begins at sunset... Be the first team to reach the final location and win a [color=#3b78e2][i]huge[/i][/color] prize!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Last year my team stayed up until dawn and didn't make it past the third riddle.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But this year you've got me... Not to mention our `reinforcements.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But this year you've got me... Not to mention our [color=#3b78e2][i]reinforcements.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I almost forgot! Hector, Sam and Amanda should be here soon, right? I can't believe they drove all this way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's going to be nice to see some familiar faces...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know you've been a little homesick...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which is exactly why I'm so excited to see everyone! It'll be just like old times!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: About that... Just don't be too surprised if things aren't quite how you remember them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: After all, people can change a `lot` during their first year at college.
nodes.text_bbcode: After all, people can change a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] during their first year at college.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just like how you started drinking coffee, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, at my core, I'm the same, sweet $ZOE. You can tell because I...

options.label: I actually still prefer hot cocoa.
I put sugar in my coffee.

nodes.text: Just as $ZOE gets to the crosswalk, the red 'DON'T WALK' sign flashes on.
It's too late now... The game is lost.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess we're not as good a team as I thought.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe we've all just grown apart...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The loss of a friendship once held dear...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I'll write a play about this!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now that this game is over, it's time we talked about the `real` reason I'm here...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now that this game is over, it's time we talked about the [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] reason I'm here...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Who wants to hear about a `fantastic` financial opportunity?
nodes.text_bbcode: Who wants to hear about a [color=#e23b3b][i]fantastic[/i][/color] financial opportunity?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've got one word for you... `Timeshare!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I've got one word for you... [color=#e23b3b][i]Timeshare![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't how I wanted things to end...
And in her heart, $ZOE knows that...
She has failed.
